digest.component_or_area: tickets store / git repository integrity verification and repair
propositions: Pre-existing fsck baseline reports 550 snapshot_stale_channel, 10 orphan_event (all LINK/AUTO-RECOVER), and 1 intentional status_fork_resolved audit record across 561 diagnostics
Scoped repair via rebar fsck --repair --only=stale-channel must refuse tickets with mixed stale and orphan/inconsistent faults before mutation
AUTO-RECOVER orphan repair and stale-channel-only batches must commit and push through the existing batched repair engine with resumable --limit and push-failure abort
Disposable rehearsal and live quiet-window execution must reduce repairable diagnostics to zero while preserving the four intentional status_fork_resolved audit records
Exact pre-repair and post-repair diagnostic manifests, bundle backup/restore, and safety tooling review (Gerrit 1391) must be verified before and attested after live mutation
